title: trailing parameters take default values, positionally and by name
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

stdout.text:
hello, Ann! [system]
hi, Bob? [system]
hello, Cy! hello, Cy! [test]
hello, Dee. hello, Dee. hello, Dee. [system]

provenance.expected_basis: a left-out trailing parameter takes its declared default, evaluated at the call in the declaration's scope; named arguments may leave out any defaulted parameter.
